playbookOutputs: NCR acknowledgement of application (CP application number)
Post-registration statutory compliance roadmap (Form 39 & Form 40 guide)
playbookCommonFailures: Bank confirmation letter is in a director's personal name instead of the company's registered legal name
Bank confirmation letter or digital verification reference older than 3 months
Criminal clearance certificate / police clearance older than 6 months or missing for any active director
Certified ID copies of directors certified more than 3 months prior to submission
SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN not in 'Compliant' status at time of lodgement
Proof of payment for NCR application fee missing the CIPC enterprise registration number as deposit reference
Form NCR 2 missing initials on bottom of each page or missing Section 8 declaration signature
Board / Sole Director Resolution authorising the signatory missing or unexecuted
Accounting Officer appointment letter or acceptance letter (CIBA #3561) missing

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (CIPC Certificate COR14.3 / Disclosure)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2 for a CC) and latest Disclosure Certificate showing the legal entity name, enterprise registration number, registered office address, and all active directors. Must match the entity the order is placed for.

informationToProvide.label: Valid bank confirmation letter (in the business name, not older than 3 months)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter from a registered South African bank in the COMPANY's registered legal name, dated within 3 months. Must include an official bank date stamp or digital verification QR code / hash. A regular bank statement is NOT accepted by the NCR.

informationToProvide.label: Tax Clearance Status Certificate / TCS PIN
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN letter for the applicant entity confirming 'Good Standing / Compliant' tax status. The PIN is verified on SARS eFiling prior to statutory pack lodgement.

informationToProvide.label: Auditor / Accounting Officer appointment letter
informationToProvide.aiHint: Statutory letter appointing a registered Accounting Officer. If the client has no existing appointment, the agent automatically drafts the My Accountant appointment & acceptance letters signed by Kevin Freese (CIBA #3561 / PR-0098553).

informationToProvide.label: Proof of payment of the NCR non-refundable application fee (R550 / R1,800)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank proof of payment for the NCR statutory application fee paid to the National Credit Regulator's bank account. Must clearly show the company's CIPC Registration Number as the payment reference.

informationToProvide.label: Criminal clearance certificates (not older than 6 months) for all directors
informationToProvide.aiHint: SAPS Police Clearance Certificate or accredited biometric AFIS criminal record check per active director, issued within 6 months. Every director listed on the CIPC CoR14.3 must have a valid clearance certificate.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all directors (certified within 3 months)
informationToProvide.aiHint: High-resolution color copies of South African Smart ID Cards (both sides), Green Barcoded ID Books, or Foreign Passports for all active directors, certified by a Commissioner of Oaths within the last 3 months.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect application requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every required statutory document uploaded and all questionnaire fields answered
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing; name each document specifically and explain why the NCR requires it. Remind the client that certified ID copies must be within 3 months, criminal clearances within 6 months, and bank confirmation within 3 months. Ensure order status is set to 'Waiting on Customer'. Do not promise an NCR turnaround shorter than 60 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against NCR statutory requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The applicant entity is the credit provider company, never the ordering individual. Verify that the bank confirmation letter and CoR14.3 match the exact registered entity name. Cross-check all director names on the CoR14.3 against ID copies and police clearances — every active director must have both. Flag any missing director documents for Kevin's review.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Confirm tax compliance status on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: TCS shows Compliant on SARS eFiling on the day of submission
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify the entity's TCS PIN on SARS eFiling. If the status is non-compliant, stop immediately and draft a client notification in Communication History detailing outstanding tax returns or liabilities. Do not assemble or lodge the pack with the NCR.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft NCR Form 2, fee annexure, accounting officer appointment, board resolution, and POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Drafts generated from verified facts and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fill every structured field from extracted facts and questionnaire responses. Never invent operational areas, languages, or shareholding percentages — flag blanks for client confirmation. Populate Form NCR 2, Fee Annexure, Accounting Officer Appointment & Acceptance Letters (Kevin Freese, CIBA #3561 / PR-0098553), Board Resolution, and Power of Attorney.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send statutory pack to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed Form 2 (initialled on all pages), Board Resolution, and POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the approved drafts to Communication History with clear signing instructions: (1) Initial every single page of Form NCR 2 at the bottom right, (2) Sign Section 8 Declaration in full, (3) Sign the Board Resolution & Power of Attorney, (4) Return the scanned document pack as a single high-quality PDF. Keep order status as 'Waiting on Customer'.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Email complete application pack to the NCR
fulfillmentChecklist.expectedReply: NCR acknowledgement email with application reference (e.g. CP1090, CP1188)
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Pack emailed to applications@ncr.org.za (CC registrations@ncr.org.za and client) and order status transitioned to Waiting on External
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Attach the complete 10-part statutory dossier: (1) Signed & initialled Form NCR 2, (2) Fee Annexure, (3) Proof of fee payment with Reg No reference, (4) CIPC CoR14.3 & Disclosure, (5) Certified Director IDs (<3 months), (6) Police Clearances (<6 months), (7) Bank Confirmation Letter (<3 months), (8) SARS TCS PIN document, (9) Accounting Officer Appointment & Acceptance Letters (CIBA #3561), (10) Board Resolution & POA. Immediately transition order status to 'Waiting on External' upon dispatch and log in Communication History.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for NCR decision and automated SLA follow-ups
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: NCRCP registration certificate or formal query letter received from the NCR
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Keep order status in 'Waiting on External'. When the NCR issues the Acknowledgement Letter / Application Number (e.g. CP1090, CP1188), record the CP reference in the order notes, upload the letter to Communication History, and notify the client. Send polite follow-up emails to registrations@ncr.org.za at Day 30, Day 60, and Day 75 quoting the CP reference. If the NCR raises a query, draft a proposal for Kevin with the query text and required rectification.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver NCR Certificate, NCRCP Number, and Compliance Roadmap to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official NCR Certificate and NCRCP registration number delivered to client in Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the official NCR Registration Certificate and NCRCP Number to the client. Provide an executive statutory compliance onboarding advisory detailing ongoing NCR obligations: annual Form 39 / 40 compliance reporting, annual registration renewal fee, credit bureau submission mandates, and National Consumer Tribunal adherence. Offer My Accountant's ongoing annual compliance retainer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off and order completion
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms all deliverables are fulfilled and order transitions to Completed
